plan.summary:
Webhook payloads are now normalized and signed with a real HMAC.

- `Event` trims whitespace from the event name.
- `Sign` now returns a hex HMAC of the body using the secret. Before, it returned only the hex of the body, and the secret was not used.
plan.riskRationale: The signing change affects webhook authentication. Receivers that verify old signatures will reject new ones. The trim changes the event name value that is sent.
plan.storyArc: Webhook payloads need a stable event name and a signature that proves the sender knows the secret. First the event name is normalized. Then the signature is changed to use the secret.

topics.title: Sign webhook bodies with HMAC
topics.narrativeBrief: How does Sign change from an unkeyed encoding to a keyed signature? Verify what hmacx.Sum computes and that the secret is now an input.

topics.title: Trim whitespace from event names
topics.narrativeBrief: What does Event return now? Check that strings is imported and whether callers depend on the old untrimmed value.
